policies.text: Carrier preferred designation is granted when an air operator holds a valid international safety credential and completes a minimum of 400 long-haul flights annually.
Cargo transport eligibility is granted to freight firms operating more than 20 heavy trucks.
Luxury hospitality endorsement requires a customer satisfaction score of at least 90 percent over the previous year.
Tier-one transit provider status is awarded to a coach company accumulating over 750,000 passenger miles annually.
High-capacity sea carrier standing is conferred upon any tour provider possessing at least 10 passenger vessels.
Approved rail operator designation is extended to any train service maintaining an official national safety credential.
Executive booking allocation is granted to an operator achieving preferred carrier designation.
